in_marathi.name: Bhagirathi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of the sacred Ganga
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhagirathi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhagirathi is the revered name of Goddess Ganga, the divine river in Hindu mythology. She is believed to purify the soul and bestow blessings of peace and prosperity.
